tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Name, description, address, phone, email, website and links for Demo Bakery (fictional).

tools.name: get_hours
tools.description: Opening hours for Demo Bakery (fictional), as published by the owner.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Products, services or menu items offered by Demo Bakery (fictional), with prices when known. Optional text filter.

tools.name: start_order
tools.description: Get the official online ordering or checkout link for Demo Bakery (fictional). No order is placed by this tool.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Leave a message for Demo Bakery (fictional). It is delivered to the owner (dashboard, plus their notification channel on paid plans); the owner replies to reply_to. Only send with the user's consent.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business_info · Public sink: get_business_info, send_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business_info · Public sink: get_business_info, send_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
